title: VICAL: Vicinal Consistency Alignment for Long-Tailed Visual Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2609.04948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-expert models have become the dominant paradigm for long-tailed learning, largely attributed to their presumed ability to benefit from expert diversity. However, we revisit this central assumption and reveal that diversity induced by logit adjustment or explicit regularizers does not guarantee better ensemble accuracy. Our work suggests that multi-expert models benefit more from variance reduction than diversity maximization. We introduce \textbf{VICAL}, a \textbf{VI}cinal \textbf{C}onsistency \textbf{AL}ignment framework that improves long-tailed recognition not by enforcing expert diversity, but by reducing prediction variance. Specifically, our approach comprises two key components: Self-Consistency Learning and Deep Ensemble Distillation. translated_title: VICAL：用于长尾视觉识别的邻域一致性对齐
translated_abstract: 多专家模型已成为长尾学习的主流范式，这在很大程度上归因于其被认为能够从专家多样性中受益。然而，我们重新审视了这一核心假设，并揭示了由logit调整或显式正则化器所诱导的多样性并不能保证更好的集成精度。我们的工作表明，多专家模型从方差缩减中获得的收益大于从多样性最大化中获得的收益。我们提出了VICAL，一个邻域一致性对齐框架，它不是通过强制专家多样性，而是通过降低预测方差来改进长尾识别。具体而言，我们的方法包含两个关键组件：自一致性学习和深度集成蒸馏。自一致性学习抑制对不稳定高频信息的依赖，平滑局部损失景观并缓解过拟合，尤其是对于尾部类别。深度集成蒸馏（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出VICAL框架，揭示多专家模型的关键收益来自预测方差缩减而非专家多样性最大化，并通过自一致性学习与深度集成蒸馏两个组件显著提升长尾视觉识别性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes VICAL, revealing that multi-expert models benefit more from reducing prediction variance than from maximizing expert diversity, and improves long-tailed visual recognition via Self-Consistency Learning and Deep Ensemble Distillation.
